newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE SALVAGES POINT FOR RANGERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE SALVAGES POINT FOR RANGERS.

text.p: England midfielder Paul Gascoigne spared Glasgow Rangers' blushes with the equaliser in a 1-1 draw at struggling Kilmarnock on Wednesday.
The result put leaders Rangers nine points ahead of their nearest challengers for the Scottish premier division title, city rivals Celtic, who have a game in hand.
Kilmarnock jolted the defending champions in the 46th minute with a well-taken goal from Colin McKee.

Rangers got back on terms in the 77th minute when Dane Brian Laudrup provided the cross from which a header by Gascoigne was pushed onto the bar by the keeper, but the England international made no mistake from the rebound.
